pageProps.title: Odeng Restaurant Lotte Mall Gimpo Airport Branch
pageProps.review: Odeng Restaurant at Lotte Mall Gimpo Airport provides budae-jjigae with a clear and clean broth. The basic ingredients can be a bit disappointing, so adding assorted toppings is recommended for a hearty meal. It's a decent Korean restaurant.
